description: This file declares the ResourceManager class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. The class implements a plugin interface for managing resources, including methods for initialization, deinitialization, and information retrieval. It also defines several RPC methods related to AV blocking and TTS resource reservation, along with internal data members for managing state.

classes.name: ResourceManager
classes.description: A plugin class managing resource control, including AV blocking and TTS resources, implementing the plugin and RPC interfaces.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given shell service.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up the plugin before shutdown.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns version and status info about the plugin.

methods.name: setAVBlockedWrapper
methods.description: RPC method wrapper to set AV blocking status for a client.

methods.name: getBlockedAVApplicationsWrapper
methods.description: RPC method wrapper to retrieve list of applications blocked for AV.

methods.name: reserveTTSResourceWrapper
methods.description: RPC method wrapper to reserve TTS resource for a client.

methods.name: setAVBlocked
methods.description: Internal method to update AV block status for a specified client.

methods.name: getBlockedAVApplications
methods.description: Internal method to get list of applications currently blocked.

methods.name: reserveTTSResource
methods.description: Internal method to reserve TTS resource for a client.
